title: Document evidence core patterns

reviewQuestions: Do observation and digest resolve to one immutable byte snapshot?
Which source label can travel while the authorized local locator stays with its owner?
What proves that a target belongs to this workflow before replacement?
Which accepted state is restored when promotion stops?
decisionRules: Read a source once, then route that snapshot to observation and digesting.
Carry a locator-safe source name and an explicit review standing with captured evidence.
Recognize owned output before replacement and preserve prior accepted state through promotion.

semanticMarkers.meaning: One source snapshot, one digest identity, visible review standing, owned output, and recoverable promotion.
A pipeline that re-reads mutable input or replaces a directory whose ownership and recovery route are unspecified.
Source-byte reuse, locator-safe serialization, exact sentinels, explicit replacement, and rollback preserve the inspectable route.

instructionYields.instruction: Form one immutable byte snapshot before observation, then compute source identity from that same value.
Trace the captured name, digest, engine configuration, source class, and review standing together.
Promote only recognized output and keep prior accepted state available until successor promotion settles.
